references.text: The great commandment to love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul, as repeated in Deuteronomy 10:12
The command to fear the Lord your God and serve him, the same theme found in Deuteronomy 10:12
Micah summarizes what the Lord requires: to do justice, love mercy, and walk humbly with your God, parallel to the requirements in Deuteronomy 10:12
Repetition of the command to love the Lord and serve him with all one's heart and all one's soul
Moses commands the people to love the Lord, walk in his ways, and keep his commands, the same theme as in Deuteronomy 10:12
Joshua exhorts the people to love the Lord, walk in his ways, keep his commands, and serve him with all their heart and soul
Samuel exhorts the people to fear the Lord and serve him faithfully with all their heart
Jesus quotes the great commandment to love the Lord your God with all your heart, all your soul, and all your mind
Jesus restates the great commandment to love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, mind, and strength
The lawyer quotes the command to love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, strength, and mind
